metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Remaining Properties Audit Checklist (Stage 2 - Batch 1)
metadata.description: Partial checklist for non-boundary properties. This batch covers the first 20 node properties from the property catalog.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-USER-IDLE transitions require validation by receiving components
checklist.description: Verify that all transitions from the untrusted STATE-USER-IDLE state pass through validation nodes before causing any state changes in trusted components.
detection_procedure: 1. Identify all outgoing edges from STATE-USER-IDLE in the program graph
2. For each edge, verify it leads to an action node that performs validation
3. Confirm no direct path exists from STATE-USER-IDLE to trusted state modification
4. Review wrap(), unwrap(), transfer() entry points for validation
5. Verify require/revert statements exist at each entry point

executable_checks.command: Review all public/external functions callable by users
executable_checks.assertion: All user-callable functions have input validation at entry
No missing validation findings on user-facing functions

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-001-STATE-USER-IDLE -> Node STATE-USER-IDLE. This is the initial user state representing untrusted actors. Security depends on validation at every trust boundary crossing.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING only reachable via valid unwrap completion
checklist.description: Verify that the state representing user possession of underlying tokens can only be reached through successful completion of the unwrap operation flow.
detection_procedure: 1. Trace all paths that result in underlying token transfer to user
2. Verify unwrap() is the only function that transfers underlying to users
3. Confirm unwrap requires prior zERC20 burn
4. Check for any alternative paths to underlying transfer
5. Verify no reentrancy allows premature underlying access

executable_checks.assertion: Underlying transfer only occurs after successful burn

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-002-STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING -> Node STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING. User token possession must follow proper unwrap protocol.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 only reachable via wrap or teleport completion
checklist.description: Verify that users can only obtain zERC20 tokens through the two authorized pathways: wrap (LiquidityManager) or teleport (Verifier).
detection_procedure: 1. Enumerate all paths to zERC20 balance increase
2. Verify only mint() and teleport() can increase supply
3. Confirm transfer cannot create tokens (conservation)
4. Check for any inheritance-based minting bypass
5. Verify initializer cannot grant arbitrary tokens

executable_checks.assertion: Only 2 paths to _mint: mint() and teleport()
Total supply equals minted minus burned

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-003-STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 -> Node STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20. CRITICAL: zERC20 possession must follow authorized minting paths.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP enforces BN254 field constraints on wrap amount
checklist.description: Verify that wrap requests are validated against the BN254 scalar field constraint (value <= 2^248-1) before processing.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate wrap() function in LiquidityManager
2. Trace amount parameter to mint call
3. Verify zERC20._afterTokenTransfer enforces MAX_VALUE check
4. Confirm wrap reverts if resulting balance > 2^248-1
5. Test boundary case: wrap that would exceed MAX_VALUE

executable_checks.assertion: Wrap reverts for amounts exceeding MAX_VALUE

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-004-STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP -> Node STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP. CRITICAL: BN254 field constraint must be enforced for ZK circuit compatibility.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-REWARD uses floor rounding for wrap rewards
checklist.description: Verify that the incentive curve calculation uses floor rounding for rewards to prevent protocol loss from reward overpayment.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate IncentiveLib.computeIncentive function
2. Identify the rounding direction for reward calculation
3. Verify floor division is used (not ceiling)
4. Test with amounts that produce fractional results
5. Confirm reward <= expected_reward for all inputs
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-005-ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-REWARD -> Node ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-REWARD. Floor rounding protects protocol from overpaying rewards.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY transfers exact requested amount
checklist.description: Verify that LiquidityManager receives the exact amount requested in transferFrom, with explicit warning about fee-on-transfer token incompatibility.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the transferFrom call in wrap()
2. Verify no balance-before/after check is performed
3. Document that FoT tokens are NOT SUPPORTED
4. Check deployment documentation for FoT prohibition
5. Recommend balance delta check for defense-in-depth

executable_checks.command: Review wrap() for balance delta verification

executable_checks.assertion: Test with mock FoT token to verify behavior

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-006-ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY -> Node ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY. CRITICAL: Fee-on-transfer tokens are NOT SUPPORTED. Deployment policy must prohibit FoT tokens.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20 requires authorized minter
checklist.description: Verify that the zERC20.mint() function is protected by onlyMinter modifier restricting calls to the authorized LiquidityManager address.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate zERC20.mint() function
2. Verify onlyMinter modifier is applied
3. Confirm minter() returns LiquidityManager address
4. Test mint() call from unauthorized address
5. Verify minter cannot be changed without owner authorization
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-007-ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20 -> Node ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20. CRITICAL: Minting authorization is fundamental to protocol security.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE implies atomicity of pull+mint operations
checklist.description: Verify that the wrap operation is atomic - underlying tokens are held by LiquidityManager and zERC20 are minted to user, or the entire operation reverts.
detection_procedure: 1. Review wrap() function for operation ordering
2. Verify transferFrom occurs before mint
3. Confirm no intermediate state allows partial completion
4. Check reentrancy guard prevents callback exploitation
5. Test failure scenarios at each step

executable_checks.assertion: Wrap either completes fully or reverts completely

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-008-STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE -> Node STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE. Atomicity ensures no partial state corruption.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-LM-AWAITING-UNWRAP requires sufficient zERC20 balance
checklist.description: Verify that unwrap requests are validated against user's zERC20 balance before processing.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate unwrap() function in LiquidityManager
2. Trace amount parameter to burn call
3. Verify ERC20 burn reverts on insufficient balance
4. Confirm no path allows burning more than user holds
5. Test unwrap with amount > balance

executable_checks.assertion: Unwrap reverts when amount > zERC20 balance

executable_checks.command: Verify burn is called before underlying transfer
executable_checks.assertion: Burn precedes transfer in execution flow

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-009-STATE-LM-AWAITING-UNWRAP -> Node STATE-LM-AWAITING-UNWRAP. Balance validation prevents unauthorized fund extraction.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-FEE uses ceiling rounding for fees
checklist.description: Verify that the incentive curve calculation uses ceiling rounding for fees to prevent protocol loss from fee undercollection.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate IncentiveLib.computeIncentive function for fee path
2. Identify the rounding direction for fee calculation
3. Verify ceiling division is used (not floor)
4. Test with amounts that produce fractional results
5. Confirm fee >= expected_fee for all inputs
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-010-ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-FEE -> Node ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-FEE. Ceiling rounding protects protocol from fee undercollection.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-BURN-ZERC20 requires authorized minter
checklist.description: Verify that the zERC20.burn() function is protected by onlyMinter modifier restricting calls to the authorized LiquidityManager address.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate zERC20.burn() function
2. Verify onlyMinter modifier is applied
3. Confirm burn cannot be called by arbitrary addresses
4. Test burn() call from unauthorized address
5. Verify user cannot burn tokens without LiquidityManager
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-011-ACTION-LM-BURN-ZERC20 -> Node ACTION-LM-BURN-ZERC20. Burn authorization prevents unauthorized token destruction.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-TRANSFER-UNDERLYING sends correct (amount - fee) to user
checklist.description: Verify that the underlying token transfer in unwrap sends exactly (amount - fee) to the user after zERC20 burn.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the underlying transfer in unwrap()
2. Verify transfer amount equals (burnAmount - fee)
3. Confirm fee calculation occurs before transfer
4. Check for underflow protection on (amount - fee)
5. Test edge cases: zero fee, maximum fee
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-012-ACTION-LM-TRANSFER-UNDERLYING -> Node ACTION-LM-TRANSFER-UNDERLYING. Correct transfer amount is essential for user trust.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE implies atomicity of burn+transfer operations
checklist.description: Verify that the unwrap operation is atomic - zERC20 is burned and underlying transferred, or the entire operation reverts.
detection_procedure: 1. Review unwrap() function for operation ordering
2. Verify burn occurs before underlying transfer
3. Confirm no intermediate state allows partial completion
4. Check reentrancy guard prevents callback exploitation
5. Test failure scenarios at each step

executable_checks.assertion: Unwrap either completes fully or reverts completely

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-013-STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE -> Node STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE. Atomicity ensures no partial state corruption.

checklist.title: Verify low liquidity state triggers high fee via incentive curve (no revert)
checklist.description: NOTE: This state represents low liquidity scenario where unwrap does NOT revert. Instead, the incentive curve increases the fee to reduce output amount. Verify that fee calculation correctly reflects liquidity scarcity.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate fee calculation in unwrap() using incentive curve
2. Verify fee increases as liquidity decreases
3. Confirm unwrap does NOT revert on low liquidity
4. Test unwrap when liquidity is low (expect high fee, low output)
5. Verify feeSurplus is correctly accounted for in available liquidity calculation

executable_checks.assertion: Unwrap succeeds with higher fee when liquidity is low

executable_checks.command: Verify incentive curve formula increases fee as liquidity decreases
executable_checks.assertion: Fee = f(liquidity) where f is monotonically decreasing in liquidity

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-014-STATE-UNWRAP-FAILED-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY -> Node STATE-UNWRAP-FAILED-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY. DESIGN: Unwrap does NOT revert. Low liquidity is handled by increasing fee via incentive curve, reducing output amount.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-ZERC20-AWAITING-TRANSFER requires sufficient sender balance
checklist.description: Verify that zERC20 transfer requests are validated against sender's balance before processing.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate transfer() function in zERC20
2. Verify ERC20._transfer checks sender balance
3. Confirm revert occurs before any balance modification
4. Test transfer with amount > balance
5. Verify transferFrom has same protection

executable_checks.assertion: Transfer reverts when amount > sender balance

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-015-STATE-ZERC20-AWAITING-TRANSFER -> Node STATE-ZERC20-AWAITING-TRANSFER. Balance check is inherited from OpenZeppelin ERC20.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-ZERC20-VALIDATE-VALUE enforces BN254 field constraint
checklist.description: CRITICAL: Verify that zERC20 _afterTokenTransfer hook enforces value <= 2^248-1 on all transfers, mints, and burns to maintain ZK circuit compatibility.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate _afterTokenTransfer hook in zERC20
2. Verify MAX_VALUE constant equals 2^248-1
3. Confirm check: balanceOf(to) <= MAX_VALUE
4. Verify check applies to mint, burn, and transfer
5. Test boundary case: transfer resulting in balance = MAX_VALUE + 1

executable_checks.assertion: Operations exceeding MAX_VALUE revert with ValueTooLarge

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-016-ACTION-ZERC20-VALIDATE-VALUE -> Node ACTION-ZERC20-VALIDATE-VALUE. CRITICAL: BN254 field constraint is essential for ZK circuit soundness.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-BALANCES maintains conservation of value
checklist.description: Verify that balance updates correctly decrement sender and increment recipient by exact transfer value, maintaining token conservation.
detection_procedure: 1. Review _transfer implementation in zERC20/ERC20
2. Verify: sender_balance -= amount, recipient_balance += amount
3. Confirm Solidity 0.8+ overflow protection is active
4. Check for any balance manipulation hooks
5. Test conservation: sum(balances) == totalSupply after each operation
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-017-ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-BALANCES -> Node ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-BALANCES. Conservation of value is fundamental to token integrity.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN uses SHA-256 with 248-bit truncation
checklist.description: CRITICAL: Verify that hash chain update correctly appends (to, value) using SHA-256 truncated to 248 bits for ZK circuit compatibility.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate hash chain update logic in zERC20
2. Verify SHA-256 is used (not keccak256)
3. Confirm truncation to 248 bits matches circuit
4. Verify hash is computed as sha256(prevHash, to, value)
5. Compare with ZK circuit hash computation

executable_checks.command: Compare on-chain hash with circuit hash
executable_checks.assertion: Hash functions match between contract and circuit

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-018-ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN -> Node ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN. CRITICAL: Hash chain integrity is essential for ZK proof generation.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-ZERC20-EMIT-INDEXED-TRANSFER emits monotonic indices
checklist.description: Verify that IndexedTransfer events are emitted with strictly monotonically increasing index values, enabling deterministic Merkle tree construction.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate IndexedTransfer event emission in zERC20
2. Verify index is incremented atomically (index++)
3. Confirm no external control over index value
4. Check for index overflow handling
5. Verify no code path allows index reset or manipulation

executable_checks.assertion: Index increases by exactly 1 for each transfer

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-019-ACTION-ZERC20-EMIT-INDEXED-TRANSFER -> Node ACTION-ZERC20-EMIT-INDEXED-TRANSFER. Monotonic indices enable deterministic Merkle tree construction by indexer.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE implies all transfer operations completed atomically
checklist.description: Verify that transfer completion state implies all operations (balance update, hash chain update, event emission) completed atomically.
detection_procedure: 1. Review transfer() function for operation ordering
2. Verify all operations occur in single transaction
3. Confirm no intermediate state allows partial completion
4. Check _afterTokenTransfer hook execution
5. Test failure scenarios at each step

executable_checks.assertion: Transfer either completes all operations or reverts

executable_checks.command: Verify _afterTokenTransfer is called for every transfer
executable_checks.assertion: Hook executes for mint, burn, and transfer

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-020-STATE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE -> Node STATE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE. Atomicity ensures consistent state across balance, hash chain, and events.
